savings.reason: Sections 403, 505 and 508 concern statutory procurement, contractor terms and incorporated definitions. The FY2005 reduction and acquisition goals are not automatic order sunsets; DOE and OMB reporting and compliance commands are separate. EO:13423 has no general savings clause.
